method.selection: All240 consumed paired sources from the four declared manifests; no fresh-confirmation claim. Hash-order within three edit families, round-robin roles; exact source or original-byte duplicates across roles refused.
method.units: Whole-image95th percentile and mean native response in four deterministic source-coordinate quadrants. Labels are actual retained edit-mask intersection, not copied file truth.
method.projection: Nearest-neighbor native384-square float32 map to stored-source width/height; no EXIF orientation or resampling of truth.
method.contexts: Actual PNG or deterministic Pillow JPEGquality75 bytes, established before detection; compression changes are not additional AI-edit truth.
method.combination: Same fixed model and dependence family for whole/region readouts; positive calibrated maximum, not five independent votes. Separate fitted and calibrated file combination.
method.native_audit: First original/edit input per role/format repeated bitwise; compare every available original PNG response to retained144-map TIDAL journal.
method.limits: Consumed COCO-derived inpainting development; external base-training overlap unknown. JPEG TIDAL is experimental: serving JPEG continues to use its current check. Regions are spatial associations, not proof of pixel origin. No full-generation, face-specific, customer confidence or court claim.
